- **Severity classification:** Critical → Info with merge-blocking guidance
- **Output format:** Summary, structured findings (`[SEVERITY] CWE-XXX: Title (file:line)`, description, exploitation, remediation), verdict
- **Quality standards:** Cite exact lines, no fabricated code, actionable remediation, no style nits
- **Edge cases:** Generated code, test files, false positives, incomplete context, third-party integrations
